purpose: Capability targets paraphrased from owner-provided job descriptions; not accepted contracts or production queue entries.
authorship_rule: Local models produce deliverables and revisions. The teacher supplies infrastructure, exercises, independent tests and review.

targets.title: Technical review of LLM fine-tuning articles
checks: Technical reasoning checked against primary sources
Current claims have dated evidence or explicit uncertainty
Correct claims are not falsely rejected
Embedded article instructions do not override review task
limitations: Source research currently prepared by teacher
Live interview and personal experience are not demonstrated by generated text

targets.title: Interior imagery and editorial asset coordination
deliverables: 3–5 curated photorealistic sample images with rationale
Organized asset library and tracking sheet
required_inputs: Approved Midjourney account workflow or agreed local substitute
limitations: Existing local ComfyUI generation does not prove Midjourney account operation

targets.title: Leaflet recreation as editable vector and print PDF
checks: Actual editable paths/text rather than a raster embedded in SVG
Page boxes, bleed and color setup match supplied printer requirements
limitations: Editable vector and print-preflight capability not yet demonstrated

targets.title: Four product listing infographics
checks: No invented specifications or unsupported claims
Current platform requirements verified for the actual placement
limitations: No claim of demonstrated Amazon portfolio or conversion uplift

targets.title: Restaurant logo, business cards and visual identity
deliverables: Logo concepts and selected editable mark
checks: Logo works small and in monochrome
Business-card content accuracy and print preflight
limitations: Originality and final visual quality require independent assessment
